title: Answer to Question: The Lebanese Presidential Elections and the Saudi-Iranian Disputes
text:
Answer to Question

The Lebanese Presidential Elections and the Saudi-Iranian Disputes

Question: It is noticeable that the election of a President of the Republic of Lebanon keeps stumbling and the quorum is not completed in the Chamber of Deputies, and this has happened repeatedly, knowing that the active forces are the Hezbollah group and its helpers and the Future group and its helpers, and it is well known that behind these two sides stand Iran and Saudi Arabia. So what is the explanation for the quorum not being completed, even though the forces supporting those parties, namely Iran and Saudi Arabia, have both become loyal to America? Why do they work to prevent the quorum from being completed? Then there is another matter, which is the heated tension observed between Iran and Saudi Arabia in Lebanon, although both of them are loyal to America; so what is the reason for that? May Allah reward you with good.

Answer: The answer becomes clear by reviewing the following matters:

1- The issue of electing a President for Lebanon and stabilising the situation there is not on America's agenda of concerns at present. It links the Lebanese issue to the Syrian situation, and because it has not found the agent alternative to Bashar in Syria, it was leaving the issue of electing the Lebanese President to the futile tugs-of-war between the kings of the sects in Lebanon... But now, after its success to some extent in the matter of the truce and the negotiations, especially since it has managed to bring into these treacherous negotiations a number of the so-called Islamic factions... after this success in gathering the negotiating parties to bring about a joint rule of the regime and the opposition... if matters continue in this way, and the truce remains in place and the negotiations continue, then the election of the Lebanese President draws near. That is, the election of the Lebanese President proceeds in proportion to America's success in achieving its secular project in Syria, and the closer it comes to this solution, the closer it consequently comes to electing the President in Lebanon. And all of that is according to America's plans...

In conclusion, America's success in continuing the truce and the negotiations leads to the Lebanese solution, through the election of the President, drawing near. Before that, the futile tugs-of-war between the Lebanese sects remain in place, by way of playing in stoppage time. This is clear from following the current events in Lebanon: Hariri agrees with Frangieh, so his associate Geagea goes and agrees with Aoun! And although Iran's party is a friend to both Frangieh and Aoun, it stands aside! Knowing that had it agreed to one of them, he would have been elected through the influence of this party... All of this indicates that those tugs-of-war are not intended to settle the issue of the President.

2- As for the disagreement between Saudi Arabia and Iran, even though both of them proceed loyally to America... this disagreement is within the margin permitted by America in Lebanon. America does not now want a stable solution in Lebanon, so it leaves Saudi Arabia and Iran to compete and pull against each other according to their internal interests... Perhaps you have heard or read about Obama's interview with the American magazine The Atlantic on 10/03/2016, when he advised Saudi Arabia and Iran to coexist together peacefully in the region: (US President Barack Obama said that “Saudi Arabia and Iran must learn the principle of coexisting together and reach a way to achieve a kind of peace...” Obama added, in an interview with the American magazine “The Atlantic”, that “the competition between the Saudis and the Iranians, which has helped fuel proxy wars and chaos in Syria, Iraq and Yemen, requires us to say to our Saudi friends, and likewise to the Iranians, that they need to find an effective way to coexist together”). (Source: BBC, Reuters 10/03/2016 CE)... And as you see, it is as if he is the one in charge of the two countries, organising their affairs for them and advising them how to behave in the region, which indicates that their agreement or disagreement is according to the roles that the American White House draws for them! So if the matter requires agreement, they agree, in accordance with America's political priority...

From the political follow-up of events, America's priority now is the Syrian situation, and that is why it is concentrating on the Syrian solution through the truce and the negotiations. In this field Iran, Saudi Arabia and Turkey proceed in agreement and harmony without disagreement; all these parties have proceeded in marketing the truce and the negotiations... And when America begins the serious solution of the Lebanon issue, Saudi Arabia and Iran will be together on this line. And you no doubt see how Turkey and Iran have reached agreement in the exchanged visits after the heated tension that had been between them, and that is because America wants their efforts to run together calmly for the sake of continuing the truce and the negotiations...

I hope that this is sufficient, by the permission of Allah.

28th Jumada al-Akhirah 1437 AH

Corresponding to 06/04/2016 CE
